title: Podoma project info.json
description: Metadata of a Podoma project (projects/<YYYY-MM>_<slug>/info.json). See the "Project configuration" section of docs/DEVELOP.md.

id.description: Unique integer identifier. Becomes pdm_projects.project_id (primary key): it must not be shared with any other project.

name.description: Mission identifier, usually <YYYY-MM>_<slug> and equal to the directory name. The part after the last '_' is the slug used for DB objects and the badge (website/images/badges/<slug>.svg): it must be unique across all projects.

start_date.description: Start date of the mission / data collection (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: End date of the mission / data collection (YYYY-MM-DD). null enables endless updates.

soft_start_date.description: Start date of the strong community animation period (YYYY-MM-DD). Ignored unless use_soft_dates is true. Must be >= start_date.

soft_end_date.description: End date of the strong community animation period (YYYY-MM-DD). Ignored unless use_soft_dates is true. Must be >= soft_start_date and <= end_date.

use_soft_dates.description: Use soft_start_date/soft_end_date (when set; otherwise falls back to start_date/end_date) to decide whether the project is past/current/next and to bound points, leaderboard and badges. Taken into account at the next update_changes run.

external_statistics.description: External statistics page: if set, it is used INSTEAD of the built-in statistics (database.osmium_tag_filter becomes optional).

datasources.description: Data sources displayed on the project page/map.

teams.description: Teams used to build statistics: team name -> list of OSM usernames.

imposmMapping.description: Imposm tag mapping: OSM key -> list of values ("__any__" for any value). See https://imposm.org/docs/imposm3/latest/mapping.html#tags

imposmTypes.description: Geometry types to take into account.

osmium_tag_filter.description: Osmium tags-filter expression(s) selecting the project perimeter (e.g. "nwr/amenity=fuel"). Several filters can be separated by spaces, or combined with '&'. The '!=' operator is NOT supported. See https://docs.osmcode.org/osmium/latest/osmium-tags-filter.html

imposm.description: Imposm configuration for importing live-updated OSM data.

compare.description: OSM objects to compare against (shown by the osm-compare datasource). Same format as imposm, plus radius.

labels.description: Label name -> PostgreSQL SQL/JSON path evaluated (jsonb_path_exists) over each feature version's tags, e.g. "$ ? (@.substation == \"transmission\")". Label changes need a reinit.

live.description: Enable computations involving the live table (Imposm or equivalent), including fetching missing features from it.

points.description: Points per contribution type (built-in: add, edit-in, edit, edit-out, delete, note; others can be set by contribs.sql).

statistics.description: Configuration of the statistics display on the project page.

length.description: Enable length and surface measurement of project features (reinit required after a change).

labels.description: Enable contribution classification in labels tables (requires database.labels).

feature_name.description: Name to display to the user for these objects (plural).

osmose_tasks.description: Name of the tasks performed via Osmose.

osmose_separate_axis.description: Show Osmose issue counts on their own right Y axis in the progress chart, instead of sharing the feature counts axis.

points_labels.description: Points obtained when contributing to a given label: label name -> points per contribution type.

name.description: Name to display to the user (legend).

description.description: Descriptive text displayed for the object / issue / note.

color.description: Layer color (CSS color). Defaults depend on the source.

minzoom.description: Minimum zoom level for making this layer visible.

maxzoom.description: Maximum zoom level for making this layer visible.

tiles.description: TMS URL list. For background sources, also "mapillary" or "panoramax" for street-level imagery.

subtitles.description: Pattern -> replacement for Osmose report subtitles.

buttons.description: Labels of the edit buttons, e.g. { "done": "It's done", "false": "Nothing here" } for Osmose, { "close": "It's done" } for notes.

terms.description: Terms to search for in OSM notes (singular).

layer.description: pg_tileserv layer to display (osm-extra only, default public.pdm_project_<slug>).

attribution.description: Attribution to display on map (background only).

tags.description: OSM tags: key -> value. "*" retrieves the value from an external source (e.g. Osmose); "" forces removal of the tag.

name.description: Field name displayed to the user.

tag.description: OSM key set by this field. For select/icons setting several tags, use a placeholder starting with '_' (e.g. "_select1").

help.description: HREF link to a help page about this field.

description.description: Extensive text displayed to the user about the field.

optional.description: true if the field is not mandatory.

locationSet.description: Two-letter lowercase country code to filter NSI entries.

v.description: Value set on the field's tag.

icon.description: PNG file name (without extension) in website/images/form.

JOSM.description: JOSM remote control parameters (e.g. changeset_comment, changeset_hashtags).
